info.title: How a Realist Hero Rebuilt the Kingdom
info.synopsis: "Oh, Eroe!" Con questa esclamazione molto cliché, Kazuya Souma viene evocato in un altro mondo e la sua avventura... non ha inizio. Dopo aver presentato il suo piano per rafforzare economicamente e militarmente il Paese, il re gli cede il trono e Souma si ritrova affibbiato il governo della nazione. Per di più, ora è anche fidanzato con la figlia del re! Per rimettere in piedi il Paese, Souma si circonda di uomini saggi e talentuosi. Cinque persone si riuniscono al cospetto del nuovo re: ma quali saranno i molti talenti e abilità che possiedono?

episodes.title: "Usa solo quello che hai".
episodes.synopsis: "Le finanze del regno di Elfrieden sono in difficoltà e Soma cambia la sua politica passando dalla coltivazione di cotone principalmente per l'esportazione all'aumento della produzione alimentare, in primo luogo per stabilizzare la vita del popolo. Ma ci sono ancora molti problemi. Per risolverli, c'è un'innegabile mancanza di risorse umane, e Soma decide di reclutarle dal settore privato in generale".

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: The results of the talent search are in, and the kingdom holds a recognition and award ceremony for the winners. Five uniquely talented individuals come before Souma to demonstrate their skills, and find a place for themselves within his royal court.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: After Souma realizes the true gravity of Tomoe's ability, he ensures that it remains a secret, and that she is kept safe. Juna and Poncho host a program that shows how to prepare readily-available but unconventional ingredients during the food shortage.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Juna and Poncho close out their cooking show with their take on udon noodles. Marx steps down as prime minister, and as Hakuya fills the vacancy, he insists that Souma get some rest. Souma, Liscia, and Aisha take a tour of the castle town incognito.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: While at Lorelei, Souma overhears two soldiers arguing about whether to side with or against the new king. Hakuya reviews the political situation concerning the neighboring lands with the king. Souma and Liscia discuss the nature of their engagement.

episodes.synopsis: Souma dispatches his magically-controlled mascot warrior to join an adventurer party. After securing funding with his team of accountants, Souma sets out to build a new port city and network of roads, but runs into opposition from the local residents.

episodes.synopsis: Kaede leads an engineering corps, including Halbert, in constructing a road. As the work detail receives a royal inspection from Souma and Liscia, an urgent message from Aisha's father arrives, informing them of a natural disaster in their homeland.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: The Three Dukes meet to discuss what to do about King Souma. In Amidonia, Gaius receives word from Georg accepting his aid, and prepares to invade Elfrieden over the objections of his finance minister. Souma delivers his ultimatum to the Three Dukes.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: Gaius leads an invasion force from Amidonia into the kingdom and lays siege to the city of Altomura. Meanwhile, in Randel, the Forbidden Army constructs a fort from which they engage Georg's forces, while Red Dragon City receives its own surprise attack.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: Souma and his entourage confront Vargas in his castle before hurrying off to Randel to regroup with the Forbidden Army. A stunning truth about Georg is revealed by Glaive, leading to a dramatic turn of events with Gaius and his forces at Altomura.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: Under Gaius's command, the Amidonian army launches a full-scale attack to retake Van, but Souma and his forces move to stop them. In the aftermath of the war, there are serious consequences to be faced and plans for reconciliation to be put into action.

episodes.title: Episodio 13
episodes.synopsis: Jeanne Euphoria of the Gran Chaos Empire is sent to Van to deal with the occupation. Roroa observes the newfound freedom of the citizens of Van. Poncho locates a source of food for the impoverished citizens. Souma, Juna and Tomoe enjoy a day off together.
